fees.description: Fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move), and is passed through from your distributor. Please visit your distributor's website to find out the current fee as they may vary.

Fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move), and is passed through from your distributor. Please visit your distributor's website to find out the current fee as they may vary.

electricityContract.terms: See Flow Power Standard Retail Contract Agreement Terms at flowpower.com.au/residential/policies/
electricityContract.variation: Rates are fixed until 30 June 2027. Victorian Midday Power Saver: 0c/kWh applies from 11am to 2pm for the first 24kWh per day. Usage above the cap during this period is charged at the Solar Soak rate.

eligibility.information: Available to Victorian residential customers with a smart meter in an eligible distributor area who choose to opt in to the Victorian Midday Power Saver.

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: Ongoing with no fixed term. No lock in contract or exit fees.
